steps.prompt: Which one does something the other three do not?
options: the first — it admits you did not understand
the second — it asks for a repeat
the third — it offers your own version, so the other person can confirm or correct it
steps.answer: the third — it offers your own version, so the other person can confirm or correct it

steps.prompt: Make the question softer. Choose the version you would use with a manager.
options: Could you tell me what is the procedure?
Could you tell me what the procedure is?
steps.answer: Could you tell me what the procedure is?

steps.prompt: Make the question softer. Choose the version you would use with a manager.

steps.title: What would you say? Choose the best response.
steps.prompt: You did not hear the question at all.
options: I’m sorry. Could you repeat that, please?
steps.answer: I’m sorry. Could you repeat that, please?

steps.title: What would you say? Choose the best response.
steps.prompt: You heard it, but you do not know what they are asking for.
options: I’m not sure I understand. Could you explain what you mean?
steps.answer: I’m not sure I understand. Could you explain what you mean?

steps.title: What would you say? Choose the best response.

steps.answer: Do you mean what job I’d like in five years?

steps.title: What would you say? Choose the best response.

steps.title: Check your own letter. Which of them did you do?
steps.model: Asking again: Sorry, could you explain what you mean by…? · Could you repeat that, please?

steps.title: Отметь, чему научился
items: ✓ use the language of applying — applicant, position, application, well suited, attend
✓ talk about a career — make progress, get to the top, be made redundant, retrain, networking
✓ ask somebody to explain or repeat, without sounding abrupt
✓ offer your own version — Do you mean…? / If I understand you correctly…
✓ buy yourself time instead of going silent
✓ write an application letter with two reasons and one number
